title: NSA TREAT Men in Black unit
summary: UAPGerb tells of NSA TREAT Men in Black unit, about unspecified at NSA, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it's the supposed uh men in black uh unit out of the NSA called the tactical reconnaissance engineering assessment search team which was created by Stubbleine

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb describes a supposed men in black unit, the kind of mysterious agents said to visit UFO witnesses, inside the NSA, the US agency that handles electronic spying. He says it was called the Tactical Reconnaissance Engineering Assessment Team, created by an Army general named Albert Stubblebine, and he links it to Edgar Fouche, Prince Hans-Adam II of Liechtenstein and a set of archived emails. If true, it would mean a spy agency keeps a team for handling UFO matters.
